label: context.reference
text:
Start from the event and the behavior it should change. Inspect the current lifecycle contract, connection schema and participating runs. Follow the path from the emitter through its handler to the result consumer, including a held continuation when the handler must decide whether work proceeds.

Author the connection and exact readable bindings through granted tools. The provider's lifecycle_connection pin names the same immutable artifact. Connect the selected handler using its actual Tool, MCP, provider or worker route and give its result an explicit return path. A synchronous lifecycle.decision requires the installed lifecycle_decision verifier and lifecycle.decision.allowed mark; a plain input route cannot substitute for that proof.

Use connection-authoring.schema.json for the publication evidence and source-trust fields. Inspect coupled owner state and future templates when changing routes. Preserve accepted events and uncertain effects. Validate the parts changed and choose an observation of the affected handler or continuation when authorized; a connected descriptor alone does not prove an event was handled.
